scope: Assessment result delivery; read-only production metadata and isolated synthetic regression fixtures. No learner answers or identities exported.

productionObservation.subject: ბუნება
productionObservation.attribution: The metadata matches the reported class and likely subject, but the learner identity was not established.

findings.before: Submit waited for external result email after the attempt was already committed. The mail request had no timeout.
findings.fix: Schedule optional email with next/server after, backed by the existing Worker execution context, and bound its fetch to 10 seconds. Return the persisted result without waiting for email.
findings.test: Real start/submit handlers against isolated SQLite return with one saved attempt while email has not run; only the winning submission queues email.

findings.before: Client cleared its session before rendering. A renderer or optional callback exception then failed the catch guard and disappeared silently.
findings.fix: Keep the session until navigation succeeds, isolate optional callbacks, provide a text-only verified-result fallback, deduplicate replayed results, and retain visible retry on failure.
findings.test: Injected rendering, persistence, XP, async learning-state, autosave, loading and navigation failures; invalid JSON result; account switch; hidden and pending answers.

limits: The exact browser exception from the user's occurrence was not captured, so these defects are not asserted to be its proven root cause.
Synthetic regression tests are not a signed-in production learner end-to-end test.
Background email remains best-effort, not a durable delivery queue.

bankPlan.targetMeaning: Planning targets, not official curriculum requirements. Topic/component allocation and genuine content diversity must be verified separately.
